name: Berrien Cliane
original_name: ベリアン・クライアン
source:
Berrien is a butler who manages etiquette coaching on the First Floor. He is gentle and firm, so other butlers depend on him a lot. There are many mysteries surrounding him because he doesn’t talk about himself.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/639390891150311425/character-introduction-pv-berrien-cliane]official character PV[/url]]
